text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: At this rate, I won't be able to entertain anyone…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: What is it I'm missing? Determination? Passion? Or…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Could it be that I lack what it takes to be an entertainer?
choice_data_list: Don't give up! This isn't what anyone wants of you!
Don't give up! This isn't what anyone wants of you!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Could it be that I lack what it takes to be an entertainer?
choice_data_list: Don't give up! This isn't what anyone wants of you!
Don't give up! This isn't what anyone wants of you!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
choice_data_list: You're really worried about your performance, huh?
You're really worried about your performance, huh?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: But of course. I want more than anyone to thrill and amaze my fans.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I don't care how much worry and stress I must suffer if it means I can accomplish that!
choice_data_list: Then you have what it takes.
Then you have what it takes.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm going to fuss over this a while longer, even if it ends up delaying my progress.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I need to get back into the right mindset to race as an entertainer!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That's right… This isn't the Fuji Kiseki everyone desires…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I have fans waiting for me to deliver them a miracle!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer! I'm not going to lose again!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'll give everyone a show so marvelous, it'll thrill them to their core!
